title: Scenario
description: Everything WhyNoRun is told about one situation: an Event, an optional Follow-up event, the Repo facts and any Assumptions. A saved Scenario writes every default out.

assume.title: Assumptions
assume.description: Keyed by subject: a job key with "fails" (`"ci.yml › test": "fails"`), or a job output keyed by the producing job (`"ci.yml › changes › outputs.src": "true"`). Values are strings, as GitHub's job outputs are.

name.description: The event name, such as push or pull_request.

type.description: The activity type; GitHub's defaults when omitted.

actor.title: ActorKind
actor.description: Who caused the Event: a member, a fork contributor or dependabot[bot].

approval.description: Whether a fork contributor's run is approved.

ref.description: The ref the Event is for.

base.description: The base branch of a pull request.

changed.description: The changed files, taken as the complete diff.

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: github.event.* values the Event can't work out, as a nested object; a path read through .*.<field> holds a list of objects with that field.

login.description: The actor's login, for expressions comparing github.actor.

followUp.title: FollowUpEvent
followUp.description: A second Event that arrives while the first Event's run (A) is still in progress or pending.

runA.description: Run A's state when this Event arrives.

pendingRuns.description: How many runs already wait in a queue: max group.

date.description: The simulation date (YYYY-MM-DD). Required: it never defaults to today.

predates.description: Whether the repo was created before 2026-09-17.

required.description: Required check names, as typed in branch protection.

strict.description: Whether branches must be up to date before merging.

vars.description: Repository variables. Values are strings, as GitHub's are.

repository.description: owner/repo, with GitHub's owner and repo name characters.
